title: Structural characterization and efficient recognition of probe diamond-free graphs
authors: Luciano Norberto Grippo Min Chih Lin
summary: A graph is probe diamond-free if its vertex set admits a partition into probes and nonprobes, where the set of nonprobes is independent, such that adding edges only between pairs of nonprobes yields a diamond-free graph. Although this class admits a characterization by forbidden induced subgraphs, such a characterization does not directly lead to an efficient recognition algorithm.
